content_md:
Provocative post in The Free Press by Max Raskin arguing that [people think they can spot AI writing](https://www.thefp.com/p/the-last-essay-ai-writing-tech-books-future). In fact, they cannot.

I just wish people spent more time reading, AI or otherwise, frankly. Reading itself is drifting away, away, away.
